description: NBI Bridge Deterioration Benchmark is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Musawer Ahmad Saqif (Focus Forensics, LLC). Processed FHWA National Bridge Inventory (NBI) bridge-year panel, source manifest, benchmark result tables, publication figure outputs, formatted supplementary material, and analysis scripts used for the manuscript "Predicting Bridge Deterioration or Reproducing Rating Histories? A National NBI Benchmark." Version 3 updates the formatted supplementary material to match the ASCE Journal of Bridge Engineering submission files. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
